verticalPenalty.application: depth only; connectivity evaluated at full gauge stage

graph.bulkheadTerrainTreatment: stitched into input DEM with GDAL before graph construction
graph.stormDrains: disabled; not connectivity seeds and no exchange flow
graph.controlVolumeConnectivity: four-neighbour components within each tile/connection bin; hard structures isolated as barrier material

slack.connectivity: four-neighbour render components touching a qualified source

filling.connectivity: four-neighbour render components touching a qualified source

draining.connectivity: four-neighbour render components touching a qualified source

verticalPenalty.application: depth only; connectivity is evaluated at the full gauge stage

channels.redGreen: conditioned elevation in tenths NAVD88; unsigned big-endian value minus 32768; zero is nodata
channels.blue: first four-neighbour connection stage in tenths NAVD88 plus 50; values below -5 ft are clamped to -5 ft; 255 means not connected through 20 ft
